adjudication.rationale: The diff changes many call sites to set `destinationCalendar` to an empty array (`[]`) when unset (e.g. bookingReminder.ts, webhook.ts, confirm.handler.ts, editLocation.handler.ts, etc.). In `packages/core/EventManager.ts`, the new array-based logic does `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = evt.destinationCalendar ?? [];` and then immediately dereferences `mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration` without optional chaining: `if (evt.location === MeetLocationType && mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration !== "google_calendar")`. When `destinationCalendar` is `[]`, `mainHostDestinationCalendar` is `undefined`, causing a runtime TypeError. The finding’s broader point that tests weren’t added is true, but this specific empty-array crash is a concrete, diff-grounded defect.
